description: Angular component for configuring script-based rule nodes in Thingsboard, including form handling, script validation, and testing functionalities.

classes.name: ScriptConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending RuleNodeConfigurationComponent for managing script configuration in rule nodes.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for script configuration.

methods.name: onConfigurationSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided configuration.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns form control names that trigger validation.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Updates validators based on script language and enabled state.

methods.name: prepareInputConfig
methods.description: Prepares and returns the configuration object for the form.

methods.name: testScript
methods.description: Tests the script via NodeScriptTestService and updates form with the result.

methods.name: onValidate
methods.description: Performs validation, especially for JavaScript scripts.
